answer: Because the summit measurement is bound to the relic signature, the ledge audit verifies every quote and a replayed one fails. The inference runs inside an enclave that produces a 245 bit measurement of the code and data it executed, and the answer is accepted only if that measurement matches the published build. A farm that substitutes a trivial script for real reasoning cannot produce the quote, so it pays for the enclave anyway and gets nothing. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
